text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice [1] in the Lord. Writing the same things to you is no burden for me but is a safeguard for you. [AA]
[3] Beware of the dogs! Beware of the evil-workers! [AB] Beware of the mutilation! [4]
For we are the circumcision, [5] we who worship through the Spirit of God, who boast in Christ Jesus and do not put our confidence in flesh, [AC]
although I myself have grounds for confidence even in the flesh. [AD]

3:5-1 If anyone else thinks he can be confident in flesh, all the more can I. Circumcised on the eighth day, [6] of the race of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrew parentage, in observance of the law a Pharisee, [AE]
in zeal I persecuted the church, in righteousness based on the law I was blameless. [AF]
[But] whatever gains I had, these I have come to consider a loss [7] because of Christ. [AG]

More than that, I even consider everything as a loss because of the supreme good of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. For his sake I have accepted the loss of all things and I consider them so much rubbish, that I may gain Christ
and be found in him, not having any righteousness of my own based on the law but that which comes through faith in Christ, [AH] the righteousness from God, depending on faith
to know him and the power of his resurrection and [the] sharing of his sufferings by being conformed to his death, [AI]
if somehow I may attain the resurrection from the dead. [AJ]

[8] [AK] It is not that I have already taken hold of it or have already attained perfect maturity, [9] but I continue my pursuit in hope that I may possess it, since I have indeed been taken possession of by Christ [Jesus].
Brothers, I for my part do not consider myself to have taken possession. Just one thing: forgetting what lies behind but straining forward to what lies ahead,
I continue my pursuit toward the goal, the prize of God's upward calling, in Christ Jesus. [AL]
Let us, then, who are "perfectly mature" adopt this attitude. And if you have a different attitude, this too God will reveal to you.
Only, with regard to what we have attained, continue on the same course. [10]
[11]Join with others in being imitators of me, [12] brothers, and observe those who thus conduct themselves according to the model you have in us. [AM]
For many, as I have often told you and now tell you even in tears, conduct themselves as enemies of the cross of Christ. [AN]
Their end is destruction. Their God is their stomach; their glory is in their "shame." Their minds are occupied with earthly things. [AO]
But our citizenship [13] is in heaven, and from it we also await a savior, the Lord Jesus Christ. [AP]
He will change our lowly body to conform with his glorified body by the power that enables him also to bring all things into subjection to himself. [AQ]
